reviews.text: Kendall Pointe hospital  has been the best experience ever Dr Arturo Quiles was amazing with my Milo treatment. We are super happy that our baby has gotten better. Thank you also to the front desk lady and the medical assistant  everyone has been amazing. Definitely I will recommend this place

We were waiting for them to take us to the room but they had priorities over some other dogs that arrived after us . The personal should be able to keep track of a line and don’t make people waste their time .

Absolutely the best vets and vet techs I have ever experienced. My daughter’s dog had back to back eye infections, he can be very aggressive, so while I was babysitting him, I took him to Kendall point to help me with the eye drops. No questions asked and no judgement.  They held him for me very professionally while I administered the drops. Can’t say enough about how professional, kind and caring everyone is. Thank you all so much
Staff has been great taking care of Lamie
The best experience ever with Kendall Pointe Animal Hospital !!! My little baby is now healthy and safe thanks to all the team ❤️

One of the worst veterinary experiences I have ever had. I left feeling completely robbed and as though my pet was treated like a transaction rather than a living being who needed help.

We arrived with our cat as an emergency after he had been repeatedly vomiting and we were concerned about dehydration. Despite that, we waited approximately two hours before he was seen, while multiple pets who arrived after us were taken back first. At no point did we feel that the urgency of his condition was being acknowledged or prioritized.

What bothered me most was the complete lack of empathy and communication. Before we felt we had even received a proper initial evaluation, we were presented with an estimate approaching $2,000 containing numerous tests and procedures. Instead of explaining a step-by-step diagnostic approach—what should be done first, what those results would tell us, and what might be necessary afterward—it felt like we were being sold an entire package upfront.

We ultimately spent approximately eight hours at the hospital and received little to no communication during that time. No one routinely came to update us on how our cat was doing, what had been completed, or what they were finding. It genuinely felt as though our cat did not exist until there was another expense to discuss; then suddenly someone was available to speak with us.

After all of that time and money, we still left without a definitive diagnosis. His bloodwork and abdominal ultrasound were reported as essentially normal/clear, yet we were then told they wanted to perform another ultrasound that would cost over $1,000 more. The explanation we were ultimately given was essentially that he may have eaten something that irritated his stomach, but they weren’t sure.

I even contacted a veterinarian friend out of state during this ordeal because I was so uncomfortable with how things were being handled. Based on what I explained to them, they felt that many of the items initially proposed would not normally have been necessary as the very first step in working up vomiting. That only made the experience more frustrating because I repeatedly felt that finances were driving the conversation rather than a logical, staged diagnostic process.

The overall professionalism and communication were also extremely disappointing. Several staff members we interacted with seemed unable to answer basic questions about what was happening with our cat, and we frequently felt like we were left trying to figure things out ourselves.

Even after leaving, the poor communication continued. I was told I would receive his medical records by 10 AM, yet I ultimately had to call four separate times trying to obtain them.

I have owned pets for years and have dealt with serious veterinary situations, including a dog with cancer. Somehow, this emergency visit ended up being one of the most expensive and by far one of the most upsetting veterinary experiences I’ve ever had—without even receiving a clear diagnosis.

I understand that emergency veterinary medicine is expensive and that sometimes extensive testing is medically necessary. My issue isn’t simply that the bill was high. My issue is how the entire experience was handled: the lengthy wait despite presenting for an urgent problem, the lack of communication and empathy, the enormous estimate presented upfront, the constant uncertainty, and the feeling that discussions about additional money received more attention than discussions about our cat.

When someone brings a sick pet to an emergency hospital, they are scared and vulnerable. They deserve clear communication, compassion, transparency, and to understand why each diagnostic step is being recommended. Unfortunately, that was not our experience at Kendall Pointe Animal Hospital.

I would not bring another one of my pets here.

Dr. Gallardo is extremely cordial and pleasant and takes time to explain and answer questions. His nurse, Ericka, is wonderful! She is very caring, compassionate, and has great attention to detail.

Highly recommend!

I can’t say enough good things about Dr. Vassallo and the entire team. When June was hospitalized, Dr. Vassallo truly went above and beyond for him. He made sure to keep us updated throughout the entire process and also stayed in contact with June’s primary veterinarian whenever there was an update.

During such a scary and stressful time, it meant so much to know that June was being cared for by people who genuinely cared about him. The entire team was amazing, compassionate, and treated June like he was their own.

You can truly tell how much they care about every pet that walks through their doors. We are so grateful for everything they did for June and for us. I couldn’t recommend Dr. Vassallo and the team more! ❤️🐾

I want to begin by saying that I never would have wanted to go through a situation like this with my pet. However, after everything we've been through, I can't help but publicly express my enormous gratitude to Kendall Pointe.

Words cannot adequately describe the warmth and kindness of this place and the special way they treat our pets. From the moment you arrive, you feel the love, dedication, and commitment of the entire team. And when I say everyone, I truly mean everyone. There isn't a single person I could single out differently; each one of them treated us with kindness, respect, and a sensitivity I will never forget.

As for Dr. Gallardo, I can only say that God knows why He put him on this path and why He gave him those surgeon's hands. May they always be blessed, and may he continue to help many pets and their families as he did with us.

I am and will be eternally grateful for everything they did for Romeo, for how they cared for him, and for how they supported us during such a difficult time.

Thank you, Dr. Gallardo. Thank you to the entire wonderful team at Kendall Pointe. There are some things you just never forget, and what you did for Romeo is one of them. ❤️🐾
